headline: Ratchet & Clank reaches 94.59% as function boundaries are corrected
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 92.32% to 94.59%, with 4,882 of 5,118 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Finished totals also include original handwritten assembly, while boundary corrections changed the catalogue's size.
highlights: #90 separates eight real functions from linker remnants and matches three, leaving the game image unchanged.
#91 and #92 add movie-library, printing, video-mode and transition routines.
Thousands of readable names and shared structure definitions make gameplay code easier to follow without changing its output.
One attempted function returns to assembly because its full-build jump table differs.
#93 and #94 propose more assembler and boundary work and remain unmerged.
